topic: A road trip with my grandmother
title: Take the Long Way Home
style: Country pop, warm male vocal, 96 BPM
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
She packed a thermos and a map from sixty-two,
said "GPS is for people who don't know the view."
Eighty-one years old, she took the driver's seat,
with Elvis on the radio and slippers on her feet.

[Chorus]
Grandma, take the long way home,
every road's a story that you've known.
Windows down and the sky so wide,
I'm just happy riding on your side.
Grandma, take the long way home.

[Verse 2]
We stopped at every diner with a pie behind the glass,
she told the waitress stories of a boy from her class.
She showed me where she danced in nineteen fifty-nine,
and where my grandpa carved their names into the pine.

[Chorus]
Grandma, take the long way home,
every road's a story that you've known.
Windows down and the sky so wide,
I'm just happy riding on your side.
Grandma, take the long way home.

[Bridge]
Someday I'll be the one behind the wheel,
telling someone how this summer used to feel.

[Chorus]
Grandma, take the long way home,
every road's a story that you've known.
Windows down and the sky so wide,
I'm just happy riding on your side.
Grandma, take the long way home.
